author: TeIq
content:
Architect verdict: APPROVE.

Independent verification:
- cargo build --workspace: clean.
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean.
- cargo fmt --check: exit 0.
- cargo test -p polaris-backend --lib pattern::minhash: 10/10 pass.
- cargo xtask check-frontend-boundary: 0 violations.

Subagent kept dispatch very tight (31 tool calls). Architectural shape mirrors #17 (trait + memory impl + typed observation value + tests). Config validation at construction (num_perm == num_bands × band_rows) returns typed PatternError::InvalidConfig rather than panicking. Universal-hash MinHash with fixed seed for cross-instance reproducibility; per-instance RandomState for band hashes (within-process stable). Single-emit dedup via HashSet<(band_idx, band_hash)>.
